title: A Study of BMS-986553 in Participants With Refractory Autoimmune Diseases
official: A Phase 1, Multicenter, Open-Label Study of BMS-986553, CD19 In Vivo Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T Cells, in Participants With Refractory Autoimmune Diseases
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of BMS-986553, CD19 in vivo Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T cells, in participants with refractory autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), idiopathic inflammatory myopathies (IIM), systemic sclerosis (SSc), rheumatoid arthritis (RA), and Sjögren's disease (SjD).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* SLE participants: Must have diagnosis of SLE defined as fulfilling the 2019 ACR/EULAR classification criteria of SLE.
* IIM participants: Must have diagnosis of IIM defined as fulfilling the 2017 ACR/EULAR classification criteria for probable or definite IIM.
* SSc participants: Must have diagnosis of SSc defined as fulfilling 2013 ACR/EULAR classification criteria for SSc.
* RA participants: Must have diagnosis of RA, defined as fulfilling 2010 ACR/EULAR criteria for RA.
* Primary SjD Participants: Must have diagnosis fulfilling the 2016 ACR/EULAR Classification Criteria.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants must not have other systemic immune disorders. Other protocol-defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria apply.
